name: workbench
description: Workspace for issue briefing, brainstorming, branch work reporting, the explicit-invocation Fable 5 operating mode, visual grounding for UI fidelity, convention-aware scoped execution, test briefing, OpenAPI registry/search, and dev wiki maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Shape, report, and execute scoped work.
interface.longDescription: Workbench collects scoped work tools for Codex, including prompt/Jira issue briefs, selected-unit brainstorming, the explicitly invoked Fable 5 operating mode (a Claude Fable 5 operating-rule transplant), commit-by-commit branch work reporting with feedback, visual grounding that compares Figma/source UI evidence against local implementations, dev-wiki-aware guarded one-unit execution, goal-focused test briefing, linked Figma design inspection, user-registered Swagger/OpenAPI discovery, and project dev wiki maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use $issue-brief to summarize this issue, Jira ticket, QA report, or pasted product context.
Use $fable5 to run this task under the Claude Fable 5 operating rules: situation dispatch, session posture, fact-first diagnosis, disclosed defaults, and the completion gate.
Use $brainstorm to review the selected work unit before implementation.
Use $branch-work-report to summarize the current work branch by commit with feedback.
Use $visual-grounding to compare a Figma or source UI against a local route and identify actionable UI fixes.
Use $executor to implement one selected work unit with dev wiki conventions and scope guarding.
Use $openapi to register Swagger services or find candidate APIs.
Use $test-brief to create tests before implementation.
